Sourdough recipe. You will need 500 grams of bread flour, 350 grams of water, 100 grams of active starter and 10 grams of salt. Then do four sets of stretch and folds every 30 minutes. Let it rise for about 6 hours at room temperature until it has grown by 50%. Shape it, put it in the fridge overnight, and bake in a Dutch oven at 450 degrees for 20 minutes covered and 25 uncovered.
